Musings of Dark Passages Darkness is safe harbor to that which does not wish to be seen. Light is its enemy. In the deepest recesses of the earth lie mysteries untold, horrors unknown to man, and secrets waiting to be discovered.
《幽暗通路的沉思 黑暗，是那些不欲被看见者的避风港。光明是它的敌人。在大地最深沉的怀抱里，藏着无人讲述的谜团、人类未知的恐怖，以及等待被发现的秘密。

BatSwarm

Messengers of Night From bats we can learn much. Though they desire warmth and freedom, they spend their days huddled in frigid darkness. Enduring this daily confinement they find comfort and warmth in each other's company.
《夜之信使 从蝙蝠身上，我们能学到许多。它们渴望温暖与自由，却整日蜷缩在冰冷的黑暗里。日复一日忍受着禁锢，它们在同类的依偎中寻得慰藉与温暖。
res#60521/whatIHaveToSay[1]
BatSwarm

They are keepers of dark passageways, and feared among the ignorant. Though they have the appearance of evil, wise men know their value, and that true evil is not so easily observed.

     In observing them we can find freedom within limits, comfort and shelter with friends, and wisdom to look beyond outward appearances. What more might we learn from them?

它们是幽暗通道的守望者，为愚昧者所惧。虽生就一副邪恶的外貌，智者却知其价值，也知真正的邪恶从不那么显而易见。

     观察它们，我们得以领悟：受限之中亦有自由，友伴之间可得慰藉与庇护，以及超越表象去看待事物的智慧。还能从它们身上学到什么呢？

Strength in Failure Consider a shelter of stone, hanging freely without worry. Great strength holds it up, the likes of which men cannot attain. Yet time is a greater strength.
《失败中的力量 且看一处岩石的庇护所，悬空而挂，安然无恙。支撑它的是人类难以企及的伟力。然而，时间比它更强大。

One day it falls, but in weakness it finds power. To the ground it crashes; with a mighty force it crushes all who stand in its way.
终有一日它会坠落，而它在脆弱中寻得了力量。它轰然砸向大地，以磅礴之势，碾碎一切挡路之物。
